verdict.rationale: The evidence documents ROCm as an open-source user-space stack (compilers, runtimes, libraries) and AMD SMI as a tool that manages drivers. Nothing in the pack states that the MI325X kernel driver is open-source or upstream in Linux. An open user-space platform is an adjacent layer, not the open kernel driver this story asks for, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run this GPU on an open driver — open-source kernel modules or upstream Linux support documented by the vendor
